title: Ultrasound microcalcification cluster imaging: detection and localization
description: Exploratory physics-simulated ultrasound microcalcification cluster study. Saved-result reproducibility software and numerical outputs compare direct ultrasound, conventional enhancement and an ultrasound-plus-learned-occupancy-map pathway. Detection and localization can dissociate. No actual X-ray training teacher, clinical ultrasound validation or fundamental-limit proof is claimed. Recorded experimental compute is approximately 17.18 + U device-hours, with unrecorded interrupted computation U unknown. Code MIT; original documentation/results/figures CC BY 4.0. Figure 1 is adapted from Loizidou et al., dataset version 3, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14859694, CC BY 4.0; original clinical DICOM excluded. See repository provenance and licensing.
